paragraphs: ROC sells a Vision AI platform for defense, public safety, and digital commerce. The company works with federal, state, and local law enforcement and first responders. Agencies named on the site include DOD, DOS, NAVY, MARSHALS and FBI.

Capabilities include face recognition, gun detection, ABIS, latent fingerprint, and tattoo matchers. The product ecosystem also lists AI Video Analytics, Intelligent Biometric Access Control, Remote Identity Onboarding, a Digital Evidence Management System, and a Multimodal Biometric SDK. The site claims the number 1 global provider position in combined speed and accuracy, as ranked by NIST.

ROC describes itself as American-made and built to perform in operational environments where speed, accuracy, and accountability are non-negotiable. ROC common stock began trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market in February 2026 under the ticker ROC.

quote.text: American-made Vision AI and biometrics for a smarter, safer world.
